parameter_provenance.description: Quantinuum Selene README, Usage examples / Using Selene with HUGR and Guppy

assumptions: The four values are illustrative Selene per-operation probabilities, not calibrated Quantinuum H2 hardware parameters.
The bundled model uses stochastic Pauli gate errors, symmetric measurement-result flips, and X errors after reset.
This model does not represent T1/T2, idle-time errors, leakage, or measurement crosstalk.
limitations: Illustrative benchmark only; not calibrated to H2 hardware.
No T1/T2, idle-time, leakage, or crosstalk channel.
